[donman92] The "Shark Steam & Scrub Automatic Steam Mop" has been good for me tbh
[Ruke] I went with a roborock F25, easier to clean and dries the mop head too. Depending on use case a steam cleaner might be even better if you have pets/ if your flooring is okay with steam cleaning too.
[Ronan2001] I also have a Roborock F25, and it has been fantastic. I use it weekly on my floor tiles at home.
[jimojr] I did some research, and it looks like the MOVA K30 SE is actually better than the Dyson WashG1, especially when it comes to ease of cleaning. We’ve had it for three weeks now, and my wife is happy with it. I got the K30 SE for free when I purchased a MOVA Stellar X10 Plus Air Purifier for $399. A week later, the price dropped to $149, so I contacted MOVA and asked for a price adjustment. They agreed and refunded me $250.

[life is suffering] Dyson pricing - half the pricing is R&D cost

[life is suffering] Ah interesting. I think Chinese companies are in innovation stage as well. Healthy cooetuojs within the county
[nguyentran] I remember it was $330 in TGG before any voucher discount 2 months ago

Saying that it's actually a pretty decent mop and does do its job pretty well. Pretty happy with the purchase. I would wait until the price drops again
